title: Introducing the MCP Proxy Firewall: Stop Poisoned Neighbors Before They Poison You
excerpt: MCP servers are the new attack surface. Our Proxy Firewall scans before you connect and screens every call at runtime.
html:
The Model Context Protocol (MCP) lets AI agents connect to tools and data sources. But what happens when one of those tools is compromised?

We built the MCP Proxy Firewall to answer that question.

The Problem: Poisoned Neighbors

MCP servers are the new attack surface. A single poisoned server can inject hidden instructions, exfiltrate credentials, or leak PII.

The Solution: Two Layers

1. Pre-Deployment Scanner (free) - Scan before you connect.

2. Runtime Proxy Firewall - Screen every call and result.

Try it now
